# v91 Release of unfoldingWord Book Packages

## What's New in this Release

- This release is the first release of Daniel (DAN), Amos (AMO), and Zechariah (ZEC).

## All Book Packages in this Release

The following books have undergone a Book Package consistency check and are included in this release:

### Old Testament Books (32):

- Genesis (GEN)
- Exodus (EXO)
- Leviticus (LEV)
- Deuteronomy (DEU)
- Joshua (JOS)
- Judges (JDG)
- Ruth (RUT)
- 1 Samuel (1SA)
- 2 Samuel (2SA)
- 1 Kings (1KI)

- Habakkuk (HAB)

- Haggai (HAG)

### New Testament Books (27 [ALL]):

- Matthew (MAT)

- Acts (ACT)
- Romans (ROM)

- 2 Thessalonians (2TH)

- Jude (JUD)
- Revelation (REV)

## Changes Since the Previous Release (v90)

- [See a detailed, line-by-line list of everything that changed in version 91](/compare/v90...v91).

release.name: Version 9
release.body:
This is version 9 of unfoldingWord® Open Bible Stories.  See [https://www.openbiblestories.org/library](https://www.openbiblestories.org/library) for downloadable resources, or get the raw Markdown files below.

Note that you can use this resource on [Door43](https://door43.org/u/unfoldingWord/en_obs/), in [translationStudio](https://www.unfoldingword.org/translationstudio) or in [tC-Create](https://create.translationcore.com).

Note we follow the versioning scheme described at https://unfoldingword.org/versioning/.

## Changelog

* Updates LICENSE.md and README.md files
* Fixes image labels
* Tidies up arrows in README.md
* Fixes links
* Fixes spaces

See [v8...v9](https://git.door43.org/unfoldingWord/en_obs/compare/v8...v9) for a complete changelog.
